SELECT DISTINCT s.Country
FROM singer s
JOIN singer_in_concert ci ON s.Singer_ID = ci.Singer_ID
JOIN concert c ON ci.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
JOIN stadium st ON st.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
WHERE s.Age > 40 AND s.Age < 30;

SELECT s.Name, s.Country
FROM singer s
JOIN singer_in_concert si ON s.Singer_ID = si.Singer_ID
JOIN concert c ON si.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
WHERE LOWER(s.Song_Name) LIKE '%Hey%'
GROUP BY s.Singer_ID, s.Name, s.Country;

SELECT PetID, weight
FROM Has_Pet
WHERE PetID IN (SELECT PetID FROM Pets WHERE PetAge > 1)
ORDER BY PetID;

SELECT DISTINCT P.PetID
FROM Has_Pet H
JOIN Pets P ON H.PetID = P.PetID
JOIN Student S ON H.StuID = S.StuID
WHERE S.LName = 'Smith'
ORDER BY P.PetID;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.PetType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pet_count
FROM Has_Pet h
JOIN Pets p ON h.PetID = p.PetID
JOIN Student s ON h.StuID = s.StuID
GROUP BY h.StuID;

SELECT DISTINCT c.Model
FROM car_names c
JOIN car_makers m ON c.MakeId = m.MakeId
JOIN cars_data cd ON c.ModelId = cd.ModelId
JOIN continents co ON c.ContinentId = co.ContId
JOIN countries cn ON c.CountryId = cn.CountryId
JOIN model_list ml ON c.ModelId = ml.ModelId
WHERE c.Horsepower IS NOT NULL
AND c.Horsepower < (SELECT MAX(Horsepower) FROM car_makers)
ORDER BY c.Horsepower ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.Maker
FROM car_makers c
JOIN car_names cn ON c.Maker = cn.MakeId
JOIN continents co ON c.Country = co.ContId
JOIN countries g ON c.Country = g.CountryId
JOIN model_list ml ON c.Maker = ml.MakerId
WHERE c.Year = 1970 AND ml.Model IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT c.CountryName
FROM countries c
JOIN car_makers m ON c.Continent = m.CountryId
GROUP BY c.CountryName
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM car_makers
JOIN car_names ON car_makers.Maker = car_names.Make
JOIN cars_data ON car_names.MakeId = cars_data.MakeId
WHERE cars_data.Cylinders > 6;

SELECT MAX(CarsData.MPG)
FROM CarsData
WHERE Cylinders >= 8
  AND Year <= 1979;

SELECT DISTINCT a.CountryAbbrev
FROM airlines a
JOIN airports ap ON a.Country = ap.CountryAbbrev
WHERE a.Airline = 'JetBlue Airways';

SELECT DISTINCT a.Abbreviation
FROM airlines a
JOIN airports ap ON a.Country = ap.CountryAbbrev
WHERE a.Airline = 'JetBlue Airways';

SELECT DISTINCT a.Airline
FROM airlines a
JOIN airports ap ON a.Airline = ap.AirportCode
JOIN flights f ON a.Airline = f.Airline
WHERE a.Abbreviation = 'UAL';

SELECT DISTINCT f.SourceAirport
FROM airports a
JOIN flights f ON a.AirportCode = f.SourceAirport
WHERE a.CountryAbbrev = 'US'
AND a.City = 'Aberdeen';

SELECT DISTINCT a.AirportName
FROM airports a
JOIN airlines a2 ON a.AirportCode = a2.AirportCode
WHERE a.Country = 'United States'
AND a.CountryAbbrev = 'US'
AND a.City = 'Aberdeen';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS FlightCount
FROM flights
WHERE DestAirport IN ('ATM', 'ATL', 'BOS', 'DTW', 'EWR', 'DFW', 'PHX', 'SFO', 'LAS', 'MIA', 'ORD', 'DEN', 'SEA', 'LAX', 'SJC', 'PDX', 'SNA', 'SYY', 'BWI', 'BNA', 'BOS', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'BWI', 'B

SELECT DISTINCT f.SourceAirport, COUNT(f.FlightNo) AS flight_count
FROM flights f
GROUP BY f.SourceAirport
ORDER BY flight_count ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.Airline
FROM airlines a
JOIN airports ap ON a.Country = ap.CountryAbbrev
JOIN flights f ON a.Airline = f.Airline
WHERE f.SourceAirport = 'CVO'
AND f.DestAirport != 'APG';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_Employees
FROM employee;

SELECT DISTINCT e.City
FROM employee e
JOIN evaluation e2 ON e.Employee_ID = e2.Employee_ID
WHERE e2.Year_awarded < 30
GROUP BY e.City
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.Employee_ID) > 1;

SELECT s.Name, s.District
FROM shop s
JOIN hiring h ON s.Shop_ID = h.Shop_ID
JOIN employee e ON h.Employee_ID = e.Employee_ID
GROUP BY s.Shop_ID, s.Name, s.District
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.District
FROM shop s
JOIN evaluation e ON s.Shop_ID = e.Employee_ID
WHERE s.Number_products < 3000 AND e.Bonus > 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT D.Document_ID, T.Template_ID, P.Document_Description
FROM Documents D
JOIN Templates T ON D.Template_ID = T.Template_ID
JOIN Paragraphs P ON D.Document_ID = P.Document_ID
WHERE D.Document_Name = 'Robbin CV';

SELECT DISTINCT t.Template_ID, t.Version_Number, t.Template_Type_Code
FROM Templates t
JOIN Ref_Template_Types rt ON t.Template_Type_Code = rt.Template_Type_Code
WHERE t.Template_ID NOT IN (SELECT Template_ID FROM Documents)
ORDER BY t.Template_ID;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Templates
JOIN Ref_Template_Types ON Templates.Template_ID = Ref_Template_Types.Template_ID
WHERE Ref_Template_Types.Template_Type_Code = 'CV';

SELECT DISTINCT r.Template_Type_Code, r.Template_Type_Description
FROM Ref_Template_Types r
JOIN Templates t ON r.Template_Type_Code = t.Template_Type_Code
WHERE t.Date_Effective_From IS NOT NULL AND t.Date_Effective_To IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Paragraph_ID, p.Paragraph_Text
FROM Paragraphs p
JOIN Documents d ON p.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
WHERE d.Document_Name = 'Welcome to NY'
GROUP BY p.Paragraph_ID, p.Paragraph_Text;

SELECT DISTINCT D.Document_ID
FROM Documents D
JOIN Paragraphs P ON D.Document_ID = P.Document_ID
WHERE P.Paragraph_Text IS NOT NULL AND P.Paragraph_Text != ''
GROUP BY D.Document_ID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT P.Paragraph_ID) >= 2;

SELECT DISTINCT D.Document_ID, D.Document_Name
FROM Documents D
JOIN Paragraphs P ON D.Document_ID = P.Document_ID
GROUP BY D.Document_ID, D.Document_Name
ORDER BY COUNT(P.Paragraph_ID) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT D.Document_ID
FROM Documents D
JOIN Paragraphs P ON D.Document_ID = P.Document_ID

SELECT DISTINCT T.Hometown
FROM teacher T
JOIN course_arrange CA ON T.Teacher_ID = CA.Teacher_ID
GROUP BY T.Hometown
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CA.Course_ID) >= 2;

SELECT DISTINCT m.Name, m.Num_of_Staff, m.Open_Year
FROM museum m
JOIN visit v ON m.Museum_ID = v.Museum_ID
JOIN visitor v2 ON v.visitor_ID = v2.ID
WHERE m.Name = 'Plaza Museum'
ORDER BY m.Open_Year, m.Num_of_Staff;

SELECT SUM(v.Total_spent) as total_expense
FROM visit v
JOIN visitor v2 ON v.visitor_ID = v2.ID
WHERE v2.Level_of_membership = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, p.birth_date
FROM players p
JOIN rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id
WHERE r.player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE country_code = 'USA');

SELECT SUM(r.tours) as total_tours
FROM rankings r
JOIN matches m ON r.tourney_id = m.tourney_id
GROUP BY r.ranking_date;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN year IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_matches
FROM matches;

SELECT b.name, b.result
FROM battle b
JOIN ship s ON b.id = s.ship_id
WHERE b.bulgarian_commander != 'Boril';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Courses;

SELECT DISTINCT d.department_name, d.department_id
FROM Departments d
JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON d.department_id = dp.department_id
JOIN Sections se ON dp.course_id = se.course_id
JOIN Semesters s ON se.semester_id = s.semester_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment e ON dp.degree_program_id = e.degree_program_id
JOIN Students s ON e.student_enrolment_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY d.department_name, d.department_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.section_name, s.section_description
FROM Sections s
JOIN Students st ON s.section_id = st.current_address_id
WHERE st.other_student_details IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT dp.degree_summary_name, COUNT(SE.student_enrolment_id) as student_count
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_enrolment_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment e ON sc.student_enrolment_id = e.student_enrolment_id
JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON e.degree_program_id = dp.degree_program_id
GROUP BY dp.degree_summary_name
ORDER BY student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.semester_name
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses ce ON s.student_id = ce.student_enrolment_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment st ON ce.student_enrolment_id = st.student_enrolment_id
JOIN Semesters s2 ON st.semester_id = s2.semester_id
WHERE s2.semester_name NOT IN (
    SELECT semester_name
    FROM Semesters
    GROUP BY semester_name
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 0
);

SELECT DISTINCT t.transcript_id, t.transcript_date
FROM Transcript_Contents t
JOIN Transcripts tr ON t.transcript_id = tr.transcript_id
WHERE t.course_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.course_id
    FROM Courses c
    JOIN Sections sec ON c.course_id = sec.course_id
    JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses se ON sec.section_id = se.student_course_id
    WHERE se.student_enrolment_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT se2.student_enrolment_id
        FROM Student_Enrolment se2
        JOIN Students s ON se2.student_enrolment_id = s.student_id
        WHERE s.current_address_id = s.permanent_address_id
    )
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT se.student_course_id) >= 2
);

SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.current_address_id, s.line_1, s.line_2
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_enrolment_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment e ON sc.student_enrolment_id = e.student_enrolment_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sc2 ON e.student_enrolment_id = sc2.student_enrolment_id
JOIN Students s2 ON sc2.student_enrolment_id = s2.student_enrolment_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.current_address_id, s.line_1, s.line_2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.section_name
FROM Sections s
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sc ON s.section_id = sc.course_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment st ON sc.student_enrolment_id = st.student_enrolment_id
JOIN Students s ON st.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE s.section_name = 'h';

FROM Cartoon c
JOIN TV_Channel ch ON c.Channel = ch.id

WHERE c.Directed_by = 'Ben Jones'
AND ch.Content = 'music'
AND ch.Pay_per_view_PPV = 'no'

SELECT tv_channel.series_name
FROM TV_Channel tv_channel
JOIN TV_series tv_series ON tv_channel.id = tv_series.Channel
WHERE tv_series.Title = 'The Rise of the Blue Beetle!'
AND tv_channel.Channel = 1;

SELECT 
    tv_series.episode,
    tv_series.rating,
    tv_series.viewers_m
FROM TV_series
ORDER BY 
    tv_series.rating DESC,
    tv_series.viewers_m DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT MIN(Share) AS min_share, MAX(Share) AS max_share FROM TV_series;

SELECT DISTINCT tv_series.Title
FROM TV_series tv_series
JOIN TV_Channel tv_channel ON tv_series.Channel = tv_channel.id
WHERE tv_series.Episode = 'A Love of a Lifetime';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poker_player;

SELECT DISTINCT p.People_ID, p.Name
FROM poker_player p
JOIN people pe ON p.People_ID = pe.People_ID
WHERE p.Earnings > 300000;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Nationality, COUNT(*) AS Count
FROM people p
JOIN poker_player p2 ON p.People_ID = p2.People_ID
GROUP BY p.Nationality;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Name
FROM people p
JOIN poker_player p2 ON p.People_ID = p2.People_ID
WHERE p.Nationality != 'Russia';

SELECT DISTINCT v.vote_id, v.phone_number, v.state
FROM VOTES v;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM CONTESTANTS
WHERE contestant_number NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT phone_number
    FROM VOTES
)

WITH AsiaPopulation AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Population AS Population,
        c.Code AS Code,
        c.Name AS Name,
        c.CountryCode AS CountryCode,
        c.District AS District,
        c.Population * 1000000 AS TotalPopulation
    FROM city c
    JOIN country c ON c.Code = c.CountryCode
    WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia'
),
GNPByCountry AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Code,
        c.Name,
        c.CountryCode,
        c.District,
        c.Population,
        c.GNP,
        SUM(c.Population) AS TotalPopulation
    FROM country c
    JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
    WHERE cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
    GROUP BY c.Code, c.Name, c.CountryCode, c.District, c.Population, c.GNP
),
MaxGNPByCountry AS (
    SELECT 
        Code,
        Name,
        CountryCode,
        District,
        Population,
        GNP,
        TotalPopulation,
        MAX(GNP) AS MaxGNP

SELECT SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT country.language)) AS total_languages
FROM country
JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode
WHERE country.language IN ('F', 'T')
AND country.language = 'F'
AND country.language = 'T';

SELECT DISTINCT country.language
FROM country
JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode
WHERE country.language IN ('F', 'T')
GROUP BY country.language
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH filtered_countries AS (
    SELECT Code, Name, Continent, SurfaceArea, IndepYear, Population, LifeExpectancy
    FROM country
    WHERE LifeExpectancy > 72
),
filtered_countries_with_form AS (
    SELECT Code, Name, Continent, SurfaceArea, IndepYear, Population, LifeExpectancy, GovernmentForm
    FROM country
    WHERE GovernmentForm IN ('Federal', 'Unitary', 'Constitutional', 'Parliamentary', 'Republic')
    AND LifeExpectancy > 72
),
avg_life AS (
    SELECT AVG(LifeExpectancy) as avg_life
    FROM filtered_countries_with_form
),
avg_population AS (
    SELECT SUM(Population) as total_population
    FROM filtered_countries_with_form
),
avg_life_with_pop AS (
    SELECT f.Code, f.Name, f.Continent, f.SurfaceArea, f IndepYear, f.Population, f.LifeExpectancy, f.GovernmentForm,
           COALESCE(ap.avg_life, 0) as avg_life,
           COALESCE(ap.total_population, 0) as total_population
    FROM filtered_countries_with_form f
    LEFT JOIN avg_life ap ON f.Code

SELECT DISTINCT country.language AS spoken_language, COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM country
LEFT JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode
GROUP BY country.language
ORDER BY country_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conductor;

SELECT DISTINCT c.Name, c.Age
FROM conductor c
JOIN orchestra o ON c.Conductor_ID = o.Conductor_ID
JOIN performance p ON o.Orchestra_ID = p.Orchestra_ID
JOIN show s ON p.Performance_ID = s.Performance_ID
WHERE c.Age > 0
ORDER BY c.Age ASC;

SELECT h.name, h.grade
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN Friend f ON h.ID = f.student_id
JOIN Likes l ON f.friend_id = l.student_id
GROUP BY h.ID, h.name, h.grade;

SELECT DISTINCT H.ID
FROM Highschooler H
JOIN Friend f ON H.ID = f.student_id
JOIN Likes l ON f.friend_id = l.student_id
WHERE H.name = 'Kyle';

SELECT DISTINCT h.grade
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN Likes l ON h.ID = l.student_id
JOIN Friend f ON l.liked_id = f.friend_id
GROUP BY h.grade
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4;

SELECT h.name, COUNT(f.friend_id) as num_friends
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN Friend f ON h.ID = f.student_id
GROUP BY h.ID;

SELECT h.name
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN Friend f ON h.ID = f.student_id
GROUP BY h.ID, h.name
ORDER BY COUNT(f.friend_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT H.name
FROM Highschooler H
JOIN Friend F ON H.ID = F.student_id
WHERE H.ID = 1 AND F.friend_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS friend_count
FROM Friend f
JOIN Highschooler h ON f.friend_id = h.ID
JOIN Likes l ON f.friend_id = l.liked_id
GROUP BY f.friend_id;

SELECT DISTINCT h.ID
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN Friend f ON h.ID = f.student_id
WHERE f.friend_id IS NULL;

SELECT h.name, COUNT(l.liked_id) as num_likes
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN Likes l ON h.ID = l.student_id
GROUP BY h.ID, h.name;

SELECT DISTINCT h.name
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN Friend f ON h.ID = f.student_id
JOIN Likes l ON h.ID = l.student_id
GROUP BY h.ID
HAVING h.grade > 5 AND COUNT(l.liked_id) >= 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS likes_count
FROM Likes
JOIN Highschooler h ON Likes.student_id = h.ID
JOIN Friend f ON h.ID = f.friend_id
WHERE h.name = 'Kyle';

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name
FROM Professionals p
JOIN Owners o ON p.owner_id = o.owner_id
WHERE p.first_name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM Dogs)
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT o.first_name
FROM Owners o
JOIN Dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id
WHERE o.first_name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM Dogs)
ORDER BY p.first_name;

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name
FROM Professionals p
JOIN Owners o ON p.owner_id = o.owner_id
WHERE p.first_name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM Dogs d WHERE d.dog_id = p.dog_id);

SELECT p.professional_id, p.role_code, p.first_name, p.email_address
FROM Professionals p
LEFT JOIN Treatments t ON p.professional_id = t.professional_id
LEFT JOIN Dogs d ON t.dog_id = d.dog_id
WHERE t.treatment_type_code IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM Professionals p
JOIN Treatments t ON p.id = t.professional_id
JOIN Dogs d ON t.dog_id = d.dog_id
WHERE t.cost_of_treatment < (SELECT AVG(treatment_cost) FROM Treatments)
GROUP BY p.first_name, p.last_name;

SELECT DISTINCT d.name, d.age, d.weight
FROM Dogs d
JOIN Owners o ON d.owner_id = o.owner_id
JOIN Sizes s ON d.size_code = s.size_code
JOIN Treatment_Types t ON d.date_of_treatment = t.date_of_treatment
JOIN Treatments t2 ON d.id = t2.dog_id
JOIN Professionals p ON t2.professional_id = p.professional_id
WHERE d.abandoned_yn = 1
AND p.first_name IS NULL
AND p.last_name IS NULL;

SELECT AVG(dog_age) AS avg_age
FROM Dogs;

SELECT MAX(COUNT(*) * SUM(CASE WHEN charge_type = 'Daily Accommodation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
FROM Charges;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Name
FROM singer s
JOIN song s2 ON s.Singer_ID = s2.Singer_ID
WHERE s.Birth_Year IN (1948, 1949);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.Citizenship) AS Country_Count
FROM singer s
JOIN song s2 ON s.Singer_ID = s2.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Citizenship;

SELECT DISTINCT OFT.property_type_description
FROM Other_Property_Features OFT
JOIN Properties P ON OFT.property_id = P.property_id
JOIN Ref_Property_Types RPT ON OFT.feature_type_code = RPT.feature_type_code
WHERE P.property_type_code = 'Other';
